## audio.state

What the running game plays (play mode only): voices: \[{entity (the source's entity; null for one-shots), clip: {handle, path}, volume, pitch, playing, paused, waiting (its clip loads), looping, spatial, position, seconds (into the clip)}\], oneShots: {playing, played (since play started), dropped (more than 64 at once, a clip too slow to load or unplayable: each logs a warning)}, listener: {entity, position} (null without one) and masterVolume. Works without a sound device.
